Seasonal guide · Nov–Dec

Holiday food traditions in New York

When are holiday food traditions and where should I go?

Holiday food traditions run Nov–Dec. On the calendar: Hudson Valley Restaurant Week (Fall) (Nov 2–16), Handcrafted Holiday (Nov 14) and November Deck the Halls (Nov 20–22). Seasonal tastes to look for: Peppermint Pig in Saratoga & Lake George. Everything here is voted by locals on Local Legends Map; check hours before you drive.

Festivals

On the calendar

Full calendar →
Nov2
OtherNov 2–16Mid-Hudson Valley

Hudson Valley Restaurant Week (Fall)

Two weeks of prix fixe brunch, lunch and dinner menus at restaurants all over the valley. No tickets or passes needed, but book ahead: tables go fast.

Mid-Hudson Valley (participating restaurants) · Source: destinationdutchess.com
Nov14
TastingNov 14Finger Lakes

Handcrafted Holiday

A self-guided day across six Keuka wineries, each pouring four wines with a holiday food pairing, plus winemaker-led tastings and peeks at unreleased bottles. Tickets must be bought by Nov 9; 21+.

Keuka Lake (six member wineries) · 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. · Hosted by Keuka Lake Wine Trail · Source: keukawinetrail.com
Nov20
TastingNov 20–22Finger Lakes

November Deck the Halls

The trail's beloved holiday weekend: wineries dressed for the season, wine and food pairings, and an ornament to collect at every stop. It sells out every year, so ask the trail office about the waiting list.

Seneca Lake Wine Trail (Watkins Glen area) · Hosted by Seneca Lake Wine Trail · Source: senecalakewine.com
Nov20
TastingNov 20–22Finger Lakes

Holiday Shopping Spree (November weekend)

Food and wine pairings at participating Cayuga wineries, with a souvenir glass, holiday keepsakes and a recipe book of the weekend's pairings to take home.

Cayuga Lake Wine Trail · 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. · Hosted by Cayuga Lake Wine Trail · Source: cayugawinetrail.com
Nov21
FestivalNov 21Syracuse & Central NY

New York State Craft Brewers Festival – Syracuse

New York breweries pour their own beers inside the historic Landmark Theatre, one of the state's best beer-lover nights of the year.

Syracuse (The Landmark Theatre) · Source: newyorkcraftbeer.com
Dec4
TastingDec 4–6Finger Lakes

December Deck the Halls

Round two of the trail's holiday weekend: decked-out tasting rooms, wine and food pairings and an ornament at each winery. Sold out, with a waiting list through the trail office.

Seneca Lake Wine Trail (Watkins Glen area) · Hosted by Seneca Lake Wine Trail · Source: senecalakewine.com
Dec4
TastingDec 4–6Finger Lakes

Holiday Shopping Spree (December weekend)

The second weekend of Cayuga's holiday trail: food and wine pairings, extra tastings, a souvenir glass and a printed recipe book of the pairings.

Cayuga Lake Wine Trail · 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. · Hosted by Cayuga Lake Wine Trail · Source: cayugawinetrail.com
Dec6
MarketDec 6Rochester & the Genesee

Holidays at the Market

The Rochester Public Market's holiday edition, a December Sunday for stocking up on local food and gifts. Vendor list still to come.

Rochester (Public Market) · 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. · Source: Rochester Public Market (marketspread.com)
Dec10
MarketDec 10Rochester & the Genesee

Holidays at the Market (evening)

An after-dark holiday market at the Rochester Public Market. Vendor list still to come.

Rochester (Public Market) · 4 p.m. to 10 p.m. · Source: Rochester Public Market (marketspread.com)
Nov1
OtherNov 1–8Long Island

Long Island Restaurant Week (Fall)

The 20th anniversary edition of Long Island's restaurant week: three-course prix fixe dinners and two-course lunches at restaurants from Nassau to the East End.

Long Island (participating restaurants) · Source: discoverlongisland.com
Nov1
OtherNov 1–7Saratoga & Lake George

Glens Falls Restaurant Week

A dozen Glens Falls restaurants roll out special menus at three price points for a week. A good excuse to try that spot you keep driving past.

Glens Falls · Source: adktaste.com
Nov7
TastingNov 7New York City

NYC Autumn Wine & Food Festival

The 12th annual fall tasting: more than 100 wines and craft beverages, New York State bottles included, with artisan bites and small plates from food vendors. 21+.

Manhattan (Grand Hall at St. Mary's, Lower East Side) · 1–4 p.m. and 5–8 p.m. sessions · Hosted by Crush Wine Experiences · Source: crushwinexp.com
Nov7
FestivalNov 7Olean & Allegany

The Wurst Party Ever

Peek'n Peak's 13th annual German beer festival: more than 44 beers to sample, brats and other German dishes, and a 26-piece German band to dance to.

Clymer (Peek'n Peak Resort) · 5 to 9 p.m. · Source: mychq.org
Nov7
FestivalNov 7Olean & Allegany

Holiday Valley Beer & Wine Festival

The 22nd year of Ellicottville's pre-ski-season pour: 50-plus vendors of craft beer, wine, cider and spirits, plus live music. A Crawl Outta Fall kicks things off the night before.

Ellicottville (Holiday Valley Resort) · 3 to 7 p.m. · Hosted by Holiday Valley Resort · Source: holidayvalley.com
Nov20
TastingNov 20–21Buffalo & Niagara

November Wine Festival at the Broadway Market

A fall wine festival at Buffalo's historic Broadway Market, perfectly timed for picking up bottles for Thanksgiving dinner.

Buffalo (Broadway Market) · 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. · Source: Step Out Buffalo
Dec4
MarketDec 4–5St. Lawrence Valley

Craft, Food & Wine Holiday Market

More than 100 regional producers fill Maxcy Hall with artisanal foods, North Country wines and handmade gifts, a one-stop holiday shop that keeps the money local.

Potsdam (Maxcy Hall, SUNY Potsdam) · Source: North Country Now
Nov2
OtherNov 2–8Saratoga & Lake George

Saratoga Restaurant Week

Saratoga County's original restaurant week: three-course prix fixe dinners at three price points, plus breakfast and lunch deals at select spots. A tasty way to try somewhere new.

Saratoga Springs (participating Saratoga County restaurants) · Hosted by Discover Saratoga · Source: discoversaratoga.org
Nov6
TastingNov 6–8Olean & Allegany

Lake Erie Wine Country Harvest Weekend

Wineries along the Lake Erie shore pair a harvest-inspired bite with their wines, plus extra tastings at every stop. There's a mocktail ticket for designated drivers, too.

Lake Erie Wine Country (Chautauqua County) · Fri noon–5, Sat 10–5, Sun 10–4 · Hosted by Lake Erie Wine Country · Source: Lake Erie Wine Country (tourchautauqua.com)
Nov13
TastingNov 13–15Olean & Allegany

Lake Erie Wine Country Harvest Weekend (second weekend)

Round two of the Lake Erie harvest trail: a food pairing and extra tastings at each participating winery, with a mocktail option for non-drinkers.

Lake Erie Wine Country (Chautauqua County) · Fri noon–5, Sat 10–5, Sun 10–4 · Hosted by Lake Erie Wine Country · Source: Lake Erie Wine Country (tourchautauqua.com)
Nov14
FestivalNov 14New York City

NY Cider Festival NYC

Sample and shop ciders from across New York State, with live music and food on hand. If you only know cider from the supermarket, this will change your mind. 21+.

Brooklyn (Red Hook Cidery) · 11 a.m. (VIP) / noon (general) to 4 p.m. · Hosted by New York Cider Association · Source: New York Cider Association (Eventbrite)
Nov21
TastingNov 21–22Mid-Hudson Valley

Holiday Fineries at the Wineries

A self-guided holiday wine and cider tasting along the Shawangunk Wine Trail, with three itineraries to choose from. Pick a route and make a day of it.

Shawangunk Wine Trail (Hudson Valley) · Hosted by Shawangunk Wine Trail · Source: iloveny.com
Nov28
FestivalNov 28Syracuse & Central NY

CNY Wine & Chocolate Festival

Thanksgiving weekend at the Fairgrounds: free tastings of New York wines, ciders and spirits, a souvenir glass, a chocolate fountain and food for sale. A fun way to knock out some holiday shopping.

Syracuse (NYS Fairgrounds, Horticulture Building) · 1–4 p.m. and 5–8 p.m. sessions · Source: nysfairgrounds.ny.gov
